seoTitle: CPS Calendar 2026-2027: Start Date, Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: View the CPS 2026-2027 school calendar with official source dates, first day, last day, holidays, breaks, printable PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: The CPS calendar from Chicago Public Schools lists 176 K-12 student attendance days for 2026-2027. K-12 students begin classes on August 24, 2026 and end on June 11, 2027, while preschool students begin August 25, 2026 and end June 10, 2027. Winter Vacation runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027, and Spring Vacation runs March 22-26, 2027. Parent-teacher conference days are November 2, 2026 and April 12, 2027 and are non-attendance days for students. CPS also publishes 2026-2027 calendar versions in Arabic, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian, Urdu, and Vietnamese.

calendarFaqs.q: When does CPS start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Chicago Public Schools starts the 2026-2027 K-12 school year on Monday, August 24, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CPS Winter Vacation in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Vacation runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CPS Spring Vacation in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Vacation runs Monday, March 22 through Friday, March 26, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Does CPS publish translated family calendars?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. CPS publishes 2026-2027 family calendar versions in Arabic, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian, Urdu, and Vietnamese in addition to the English and Spanish PDF.

calendarFaqs.q: Does CPS have emergency days in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. CPS family calendars list emergency days that may be used if student days fall below the state requirement. Families should confirm the final emergency-day list in the official CPS PDF before making June plans.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for CPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day for K-12 students is Friday, June 11, 2027.

customSections.label: CPS Calendar Important Dates for Families
customSections.content: Families usually check the CPS calendar first for the first day of school, Winter Vacation, Spring Vacation, parent-teacher conference days, and the last day of school. These dates affect childcare planning, vacations, transportation, work schedules, and family routines across the Chicago school year.

customSections.label: When Should CPS Families Start Planning?
customSections.content: In August, confirm school supplies, transportation, bell schedules, and after-school care before the August 24 first day. In November, plan around parent-teacher conferences and Thanksgiving. In December, Winter Vacation runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. In March, Spring Vacation runs March 22-26, 2027. In May and June, watch graduation windows, the June 11 last day for K-12 students, and any emergency day announcements.

customSections.label: CPS Calendar Download Options
customSections.content: Use the CPS calendar tools to view the official PDF, download a printable PDF, import the ICS calendar into Google Calendar or Apple Calendar, save important breaks, and share key dates with family members. Always verify final schedule changes with the official Chicago Public Schools calendar source before making critical plans.
